title: Bind Staging operator acknowledgement to the exact convergence plan

phases.objective: Accept a Staging operator plan hash only when the locally reconstructed convergence plan is bound to the validated runtime and preflight exact commit, then stop at the server-governed handoff without provider execution.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The operator submits a plan SHA-256 to the Staging One-Click after observing its convergence plan.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Matching acknowledgement produces handoff_ready with execution_performed=false; stale or malformed hashes fail closed.
steps: Validate the runtime and preflight against the same exact Staging commit.
Reconstruct the current convergence plan and compare its digest to the submitted plan hash.
Derive the acknowledgement environment and commit locally before passing it to the shared engine.
Return the governed handoff without executing Cloudflare, workflow, database, or Production mutation.
Require live Staging certification before treating changed runtime topology as ready.
assertions: The operator controls only the plan hash, not the environment, commit, or provider target.
An obsolete plan hash cannot authorize a different exact commit.
Handoff readiness does not imply provider execution or certification readiness.
